subject.title: feat(sidebar): Recent naming parity, iOS roster pagination, approvals remediation routing

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new offset-capable `OpenClawChatTransport` contract, where existing conformers remain source-compatible but reject requests beyond the first page until they opt in?
rationale: This is an additive public shared-kit transport API rather than a purely private iOS refactor; only maintainers can decide whether explicit fail-fast behavior is the desired cross-client compatibility policy.

options.title: Accept the additive contract
options.body: Merge with the existing default fallback because the only current paginated caller is the iOS roster and legacy conformers remain source-compatible.

options.title: Constrain pagination to an iOS-private seam
options.body: Avoid extending the shared transport protocol if maintainers do not want other chat clients to inherit an offset-pagination contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive contract
recommendation.body: Merge with the existing default fallback because the only current paginated caller is the iOS roster and legacy conformers remain source-compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged sidebar redesign and this follow-up establish the strongest available ownership signal for the affected iOS and shared-kit contract.
